svg.title: From commercial buyer intent to settled recurring & CPA commissions
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-01-affiliate-funnel-to-commission-loop; chart type: process_flow; title: From commercial buyer intent to settled recurring & CPA commissions; subtitle: Five-stage high-ticket referral publishing & S2S attribution loop; chapter number: 1; epistemic tag: operating_framework; assumptions note: Numeric values indicate operating sequence; conversion and scrub rates vary by vertical.; caption: Own the pre-sell comparison calculator, first-party click_id, and email relationship rather than sending cold clicks to raw vendor homepages.; stages: label: Intercept BOFU intent; value: Step 1; numeric value: 1.0; detail: Capture '[Vendor] vs [Vendor]', pricing-calculator, and migration queries across search, YouTube, and AI engines.; label: Pre-sell & capture; value: Step 2; numeric value: 2.0; detail: Run an interactive edge fee/ROI calculator with above-the-fold FTC disclosure and optional checklist email capture.; label: Mint S2S click_id; value: Step 3; numeric value: 3.0; detail: Log GCLID/UTM context in click_ledger and pass unique click_id into 3+ competing high-ticket merchant offers.; label: Verify S2S & scrub; value: Step 4; numeric value: 4.0; detail: Ingest HMAC-signed PartnerStack, Impact, Everflow, or Ringba webhooks and hold a 15% reversal/scrub reserve.; label: Compound & re-route; value: Step 5; numeric value: 5.0; detail: Upload net offline values to ad platforms, stack sequential fintech/SaaS bounties, and cap single merchants at <=25%.
